mapper.select: SELECT id, title, summary, content, category_id, type, cover_url, status, view_count, author_id, created_at, updated_at, MATCH(title, content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AS score FROM kb_knowledge WHERE MATCH(title, content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AND status = 1 ORDER BY score DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM kb_knowledge WHERE MATCH(title, content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AND status = 1
